title: Daily Devotional #7
paragraphs: Today I read Matthew chapter 7, and I am in awe of the wisdom and guidance you have provided in these verses. As I reflect on these words, I am reminded of the importance of putting my trust in you and following your teachings.

Verse 1 starts with a warning about judging others. It is a powerful reminder that I should not judge others, as I will be judged in the same way. It's easy to become critical of others, but I must remember that I am not perfect and have flaws of my own.

In verse 7, you encourage us to ask, seek, and knock. I am reminded of the power of prayer and how it can transform my life. I am grateful for the reminder to come to you in prayer, knowing that you are always there to listen and answer.

Verse 12 speaks of the golden rule, treating others as we would like to be treated. This is a timeless and universal principle that is so important in our interactions with others. Help me to live this principle in my daily life.

As I read further, I am reminded of the importance of choosing the right path in life. The narrow gate is the way to eternal life, but it is not always the easiest path. Help me to stay focused on you and to walk the narrow path, even when it is difficult.

Verse 24 reminds me that building my life on a solid foundation is essential. Only by building on your word and following your teachings can I ensure that my life is grounded in truth and will withstand the storms of life.

I am grateful for the insights and guidance found in Matthew chapter 7. Help me to apply these principles in my daily life, and to grow in faith and obedience to you. Thank you for your unending love and grace.
